trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is nothing to do for the platinum itself — it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Treat it as the finish line of the whole run: build your playthrough around the story, the collectible sweeps and the 100% checklist, and this will be the last notification you see. One habit protects everything else on the list: never activate cheats, since a single cheat stops trophies from registering.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It doubles as the tutorial, walking you through movement, driving and gunplay with Jason and Lucia on the Leonida coast, and the trophy is awarded when the mission ends. It cannot be missed — on a new save it is simply the first trophy you will earn.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Work through every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy lands at the closing cutscene. One thing to do before the chapter ends: take the meditation offered at Jason's house. That moment feeds Positive Mental Attitude, the list's only missable step, and there is no mission replay if you walk past it.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2, where the duo's money troubles turn into their first real scores. Progress is linear, so the trophy itself is safe, but get into the habit of keeping a manual save at each chapter break — with no mission replay, anything one-off inside a mission has to be done while you are there.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and the trophy pops after its final mission. The world opens up at this point, so start the long-game habits now: scan unfamiliar vehicles for Whip It Good, WAiNK new places as you pass them, and sample each activity type once so Master of None mostly completes itself.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Save manually at the chapter boundary before pushing on. Nothing else locks away when you finish the story — free-roam continues after the credits — so the save is just cheap insurance for the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Beat the final story mission to claim this gold. Finishing it is also the key that unlocks the rest of the run: free-roam continues afterwards, and the 100% Completion checklist becomes visible (Touch Pad, then Progress, then Stats), letting you clean up everything else at your own pace. Settle any mission-specific feats first, because missions cannot be replayed.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a fixed campaign beat with no medal or optional objective attached: start it when the marker appears in the early chapters, play it through, and the bronze is yours.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, the campaign's big scripted robbery set-piece. Play it when it unlocks and the trophy arrives on completion. Do not confuse it with the free-roam robbery trophies such as Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play — those are separate feats you can attempt whenever you like.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission bronzes, it comes from ordinary story progress: no optional objectives, no medal requirement, just finish the mission when it appears.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Start it when it surfaces in the campaign, see it through, and the trophy is awarded at the mission's end. Nothing beyond finishing the mission itself is tracked.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the story mission set around Vice City International Airport. Finishing it earns the bronze, and the mission doubles as a guided tour of the airfield — that layout knowledge makes Catch Me If You Can, the unscheduled-departure trophy at the same airport, much simpler later.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A straightforward campaign bronze: play the mission when it appears and it pops at the end. Keep your manual saves at the chapter boundaries and trophies like this one never need a second thought.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Fill the in-game completion checklist to 100%. The checklist only becomes viewable after the story ends (Touch Pad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), though everything you do earlier already counts. It asks for roughly 60% of everything in the game — story, robberies, gang operations, vaults, ranges, races, part of the collectibles and 70 of the 80 challenges — so expect this gold to be one of the last trophies you earn.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Leonida hides 397 stunt jumps and set-piece leaps in total, so you need a little over half of them. Ones you have found appear on the map (Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots) and your tally sits under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. Clear them region by region during your sweeps instead of grinding them all in one sitting.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the game's 9 activity types once — races, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, meditation and the rest. You do not need to win or post a score; a single attempt registers the type. Most are introduced by the story, so late in the story stage check your Progress screen and deliberately try whatever is still greyed out.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges unlock as you explore, and gold demands accuracy and speed at once, so learn each challenge at a lower medal first, then push with the weapon you handle best. Your medal record sits under Progress, then Activities, and these challenges also count toward the 100% checklist.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — finishing is not enough, you have to come first. Learn each course with a practice run, then race it clean; smooth cornering beats full throttle on the straights. The courses span the whole map, so fold them into your exploration sweep and tick them off region by region.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeat wins on the same track do not count, so spread yourself across the map's series — street, off-road, water and air — and take one win in each. Any vehicle class counts as long as you cross the line first; if a race keeps beating you, come back later with a faster, upgraded ride.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find him at his fishing spot, accept the challenge and land the better catch under the rules he sets. The challenge can be retried as often as you like, so if he keeps winning, work the fishing progression first to improve your tackle and treat the early attempts as practice.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Cabinets wait in arcades and bars across Leonida: walk up, play, and finish a full game — win or lose, completion is all that counts. Most players earn this in passing while sampling activity types for Master of None.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's character strand by completing its final mission. His jobs appear as optional markers during and after the story; work the chain in order and the trophy pops when the last job is done. Strands also count toward Strangers & Freaks, so they are worth prioritising in the activities stage.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's character strand by completing its final mission. Follow his optional markers whenever they appear and see the chain through. Strands stay available in free-roam after the story, so this one cleans up comfortably in the activities stage if you passed it by earlier.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's character strand by completing its final mission. His jobs are optional character missions: accept each as it is offered and the trophy arrives at the end of the last one. Doing the strands as they appear keeps the activities stage short.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand is a chain — starting one is not enough, you must see 8 different strands through to their final missions, and the Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone chains all count. Stranger markers appear as you explore, so note which strands you have started and finish what you begin.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's character strand by completing its final mission. His jobs revolve around moving product: accept each mission as it appears, work the chain in order, and the trophy pops at the end. Like the other strands, it remains available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's character strand by completing its final mission. Work through his optional missions in order and the trophy is awarded when the last one ends. Complete all five named character strands and you are most of the way to Strangers & Freaks as well.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and handle the first one with care. The Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house, a balcony meditation with Lucia, can be skipped as you play, and with no mission replay there is no way back for it in that playthrough; PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase all flag it as the list's one missable step. Do it the moment it is offered, keep a manual save at each chapter break, and gather the other 17 spots at leisure in free-roam.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. His strand is the hunting line: take his missions, study animals through the binoculars to learn their habits — studying wildlife also feeds the 100% checklist — and track the one specimen he names. When the hunt is offered, follow it through in the same session so the trail does not go cold.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards hide across Leonida — in shops, bars, landmarks and out-of-the-way corners — and a set completes only when every card in it is found. There are 15 completable sets, so you need just a fifth of them: focus on the three sets whose cards cluster in regions you sweep early, and use the collection screen to see which sets are nearly finished.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-world app for tagging and scanning the world — vehicles, animals and marked locations — and using it at 100 distinct places builds this count. Make it a habit from the first hour: tag something in every new district and the trophy lands naturally during exploration, while the vehicle scans also feed Whip It Good and the 100% checklist.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The full challenge set numbers 80 — driving, shooting, stunt and exploration tests — and the 100% checklist wants 70 of them, so this trophy's bar of 50 is the friendlier one. Pick tests that suit your style and skip the hardest few; your count is tracked under Progress, so check it during the activities stage and target the categories where you are already closest.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat completely. Raise trouble together until the wanted level reaches four stars, then break line of sight and hide — swap vehicles, go off-road or duck into cover — until the search ends. Both conditions matter: your partner must be present and the escape must fully finish, so do not split up mid-chase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without your Wanted Level fully clearing in between. Plan a route of three shops close together, rob the first, and move straight to the next while the heat is still on — if the stars clear between shops, the chain resets. A fast car waiting outside each shop and your partner covering the door make it far easier.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts when you get into it or scan it with WAiNK, and Leonida's roads are full of variety, so vary your driving: scan new models whenever one catches your eye instead of living in a single favourite car. The 100% checklist ultimately wants 200 of the game's 277 base models, so this trophy is the halfway point of that habit.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, the leads' slow-motion aiming ability. Charge the meter, then trigger it in a crowded firefight — a gang operation or a busy story shootout — and drop five targets before the effect ends; headshots conserve the meter. If a fight is too sparse, let the enemies group up before activating it, and retry on the next big fight if it falls short.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, take off from Vice City International Airport in a plane you were never cleared to fly. Take an aircraft on the airfield, expect a wanted level for it, get airborne, and the trophy pops as you leave the airport behind. The story mission VCIA Takedown teaches you the layout, and doing this in free-roam keeps it repeatable.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — points at the Rhino, the game's tank, and this is one of the list's deliberately cryptic hidden trophies. Get into a Rhino when heavy military heat brings armour out, and spend time operating it under fire. The published lists agree on the wording while the precise trigger is a community-confirmed detail, so if simply driving one does not pop it, stay in the tank through a full wanted-level escape and try again.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Scope the store first, go in quietly — no weapon drawn at the door, no alarms tripped — take the goods and walk out before anyone raises the alert; being spotted mid-robbery voids the attempt. If one store's layout keeps exposing you, pick a quieter one and try at night. One clean job is all the trophy needs.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs are the heavy end of the robbery ladder: case the bank, bring your partner and a fast getaway car, crack the vault, then lose the heat — a robbery you are caught during does not count. Eight vault robberies feature in the 100% requirements, so five clean escapes also push A Long Road forward.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida: stop one by blocking or disabling it, crack the rear doors, take the cash and break away before the response pins you down. The escape is part of the requirement — the trophy pops once you have lost the heat with the money in hand.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every one of its 52 areas. An area registers the first time you set foot in it, so this is a pure exploration sweep: ride every highway, island and backwater until no region is unvisited. Do it alongside the collectible sweeps, since meditations, cards and WAiNK spots drag you into most corners anyway, then scan the map for any district you somehow never touched.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one operation for each of Leonida's 9 gangs, not the same gang nine times. Every gang runs operations on its own turf, so work the map gang by gang and keep a note of which ones you have hit. Gang operations also feed the 100% checklist, which wants 39 operations in total, so none of the trips are wasted.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach strip, order a cocktail at a beachfront bar, and drink it with the ocean in front of you, as the description asks. Nothing missable hangs on it: if it does not pop at the first bar, try another beachfront spot along the same strip.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass frontage rather than through the door — the 'classic style' the description winks at. Any showroom with a display car and a glass front works; expect a wanted level for the exit.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Find the alley, start a game of bowling there and play it through to the end — the wording riffs on the series' old bowling pastime, and the requirement is simply to bowl at the named alley. It also counts as one of the activity types sampled for Master of None if you have not bowled yet.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is one of the list's riddles, pointing at a shared moment between the two leads performed in front of an audience. Play the partner content in public places — races, robberies and events in crowded spots with both leads together — and it pops at the qualifying moment. The published lists carry the same wording without one confirmed trigger, so treat it as an earn-it-by-playing trophy rather than a checklist step.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A counter trophy: PlayStation tracks your in-game choices toward a total of 500, so it fills in as you make decisions across the story and free-roam — dialogue picks, mercy-or-mayhem moments and other either/or calls. There is nothing to farm in one spot; if it is still outstanding late in the activities stage, keep playing content that presents choices and it will complete on its own.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: succeed at something on your second attempt, immediately after failing it once. The natural route is organic — fail a race, a challenge or a robbery approach, retry it straight away, and succeed. If you are cleaning up deliberately, pick a short race, lose it on purpose, then win the retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This is the list's Easter-egg bronze: Leonida hides odd encounters off the beaten path — strange lights and stranger-than-usual strangers, mostly at night and away from the city. The published lists keep the wording deliberately vague because the trigger is a discovery, so explore rural Leonida after dark during your sweeps and investigate anything that looks out of place.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving slowly past a pedestrian or rival, swing your melee attack so the contact knocks them down like a bowling pin — the melee hit is what the trophy asks for, so aim for a clean sideswipe rather than a full-speed run-over. A crowded sidewalk at low speed gives you plenty of attempts.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; instead of spending them raw, pass them to your laundering contacts, who return clean money for a cut. The counter tracks cumulative earnings through laundering, so route every marked payout through your contacts from mid-game on and the total builds quickly alongside the robbery trophies.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Cumulative spending anywhere — clothes, weapons, vehicles, services — counts toward the total, so this usually pops on its own during a full playthrough. If you are short late in the run, Leonida's luxury shops will happily take the rest; there is no need to spend it all in one place or one session.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from property listings as they unlock across the story; you need the cash, and for some of them the story progress, before they are offered. Buy each one as it appears rather than saving for a spree — owning garages also gives you storage for the vehicles behind Whip It Good and On the Spot.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, use the app to register it; ten registrations is a small ask once you are already scanning and discovering vehicles for Whip It Good. Register distinct vehicles as you encounter them — the garages from Little Boxes give you somewhere to keep them all.
